window-1.title: net-art.org — Art projects
window-1.blurb: It's a whole archive of browser-made art by people who just wanted to build something odd and lovely, which is exactly the kind of rabbit hole you disappear into and come out of with three new side quests.

window-2.title: Garbage Day
window-2.blurb: It's the sharpest, funniest autopsy of why the internet is being weird this week — perfect fuel for someone who turns memes and viral aesthetics into whole personas.

window-3.title: Spiced Tamarind Mocktail
window-3.blurb: Sour, salty, gingery chaat energy in a glass — it's the rare mocktail that tastes like a snack stall instead of a juice bar, and the kala namak makes it weirdly addictive.

window-4.title: Inside Jen Mankins' Scandi-Inspired Brooklyn Brownstone, Redone
window-4.blurb: This one's the home of the woman who built Brooklyn's coolest indie boutique, so every corner has that shop-owner's eye — collected, warm, zero showroom energy — and I think you'll steal at least three ideas from the small details.

window-5.title: Toriei, Cuppage Plaza
window-5.blurb: A brand-new ten-seat yakitori counter buried on the fourth floor of Cuppage Plaza's gloriously time-warped 80s maze — the kind of place you have to hunt for, then smugly tell everyone about.
